svg.title: Receiver chain with its noise sources
svg.desc: Optical power P(t), which already carries the transmitter RIN, enters the PIN photodiode and becomes the current I = R P. Shot noise 2qI and the TIA's thermal noise in squared are added as current noise. The transimpedance amplifier with feedback Z converts the current to a voltage, and the Bessel-Thomson filter shapes signal and noise into the output u(t) with noise sigma(t).
